headline: Anupam Rasayan India acquires controlling stake in Bliss GVS Pharma; Kanga & Co advises sellers

detail: Anupam Rasayan India Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Mates Visa Consultancy Private Limited, has acquired 5,09,86,264 equity shares, representing 47.95% of the equity share capital of Bliss GVS Pharma Limited, pursuant to the completion of the share purchase agreement and the consequent mandatory open offer. The share purchase agreement was executed amongst Anupam Rasayan India and the sellers, comprising the promoters of Bliss GVS Pharma and certain other shareholders. Kanga & Co advised the sellers on the transaction, including advising on the transaction documentation, the open offer process and related regulatory disclosures and compliances and assisted the sellers through…
